variable.name: UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY
variable.label: "UKO_ADMIN_SECURITY"
variable.abstract: APF authorized user id for security related provisioning tasks
variable.description: The APF authorized userid to run SAF certificate creation/deletion and SAF profile creation/deletion

variable.name: UKO_APPROVER_SECURITY
variable.label: "UKO_APPROVER_SECURITY"
variable.abstract: The user id to approve security related provisioning tasks
variable.description: The user id to approve security related provisioning tasks

variable.name: SERVER_CA_LABEL
variable.label: SERVER_CA_LABEL
variable.description: Name of the SERVER_CA_LABEL to use for the server.

variable.name: MTLS_USER
variable.label: MTLS_USER
variable.abstract: The end user that is going to user MTLS
variable.description: The id of the user that is going to use a certificate to connect to UKO using mTLS

variable.name: MTLS_HLQ
variable.label: MTLS_HLQ
variable.description: The default is CCC.ZOSMF.CERT, change only if your user and PRVEKM have access

variable.name: MTLS_LOCATION
variable.label: MTLS_LOCATION
variable.description: Location where the certificate had been exported to

variable.name: TEMP_DIR
variable.label: TEMP_DIR
variable.description: The path to a temp directory for files created and removed at runtime

variable.name: MTLS_EXPORT_PASSWORD
variable.label: MTLS_EXPORT_PASSWORD
variable.description: Set to change the default password for the exported MTLS certificate

variable.name: CERT_FORMAT
variable.label: CERT_FORMAT
variable.description: Specify PKCS12B64 for human readable and PKCS12DER for binary

variable.name: EXPORT_TO_USS
variable.label: EXPORT_TO_USS
variable.abstract: Specify whether you want to export the certificate to your home directory afterwards
variable.description: If set to true, the certificate will be exported to USS after creation and the *.crt and *.key files be created.

variable.name: ACSP_REST_STATUS
variable.label: ACSP_REST_STATUS
variable.abstract: Holds the status of the server REST request
variable.description: Holds the status of the server REST request issued to the console API
